black-spiny-tailed-iguana.description: 黑刺尾鬣蜥是一種爬行動物。The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, reaching speeds of 21 mph. Native to Central America, it is found on rocky cliffs, walls, and in urban areas. It is an omnivorous species that feeds on plants and small animals.

burmese-python.funFact: 緬甸蟒蛇是最大的蛇類之一，在佛羅里達大沼澤地成為具破壞性的入侵物種。
burmese-python.name: 缅甸蟒
burmese-python.description: 缅甸蟒是一種爬行動物。The Burmese python is one of the five largest snakes in the world, native to Southeast Asia. It is a popular pet species but has become a significant invasive species in the Florida Everglades. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds on mammals and birds.

ornate-box-turtle.funFact: 花背箱龜能完全關閉其鉸接腹甲，將自己封在殼內以求保護。
ornate-box-turtle.name: 锦箱龟
ornate-box-turtle.description: 锦箱龟是一種爬行動物。The ornate box turtle is a small, terrestrial turtle native to the prairies of central North America. It has a domed shell with intricate yellow and orange patterns. It can fully close its hinged plastron to protect itself from predators.

common-house-gecko.funFact: 壁虎是地球上分布最廣的蜥蜴物種之一，除南極洲外所有洲都有分布。
common-house-gecko.name: 壁虎
common-house-gecko.description: 壁虎是一種爬行動物。The common house gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard found throughout the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is commonly seen on walls and ceilings of buildings, hunting insects. Its toe pads allow it to climb smooth vertical surfaces.

sidewinder-rattlesnake.funFact: 侎尾蛇採用獨特的S形運動方式，最大限度減少與炙熱沙漠地面的接觸。
sidewinder-rattlesnake.name: 侧进响尾蛇
sidewinder-rattlesnake.description: 侧进响尾蛇是一種爬行動物。The sidewinder rattlesnake is a venomous pit viper adapted to desert life in the southwestern United States. It uses a distinctive sidewinding locomotion that leaves J-shaped tracks in the sand. It buries itself in sand to ambush prey and escape heat.

chinese-water-dragon.funFact: 中國水龍能從四十英尺高處安全降落在下方樹枝上。
chinese-water-dragon.name: 中国水龙
chinese-water-dragon.description: 中国水龙是一種爬行動物。The Chinese water dragon is an arboreal agamid lizard found near streams in the forests of southeastern China. Males display vibrant green with white and orange markings. It is an excellent swimmer and can hold its breath for up to an hour.

west-african-dwarf-crocodile.funFact: 西非侏儒鱷是所有鱷目動物中最偏陸棲的，白天會挖掘深洞穴休息。
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.name: 西非矮鳄
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.description: 西非矮鳄是一種爬行動物。The West African dwarf crocodile is the smallest living crocodile species, found in the swamps and rivers of western and central Africa. It is nocturnal and highly terrestrial, digging burrows for shelter. It feeds primarily on fish, crustaceans, and insects.

cape-cobra.funFact: 開普眼鏡蛇毒性極強，是南部非洲蛇咬死亡的主要原因。
cape-cobra.name: 眼镜蛇
cape-cobra.description: 眼镜蛇是一種爬行動物。The Cape cobra is one of the most dangerous cobras in Africa, found in the shrublands and fynbos of southern Africa. It is highly venomous with potent neurotoxin. It is a diurnal species and an excellent climber.

crested-iguana.funFact: 冠鬣蜥能根據溫度和社交情境從綠色變為黑色。
crested-iguana.name: 冠鬣蜥
crested-iguana.description: 冠鬣蜥是一種爬行動物。The crested iguana is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry forests of western Madagascar. It has a distinctive high dorsal crest and is one of the rarest iguanas in the world. It is primarily herbivorous, feeding on leaves and fruit.

argentine-tegu.funFact: 阿根廷泰加蜥能在繁殖季節調節體溫，不僅依賴外部熱源。
argentine-tegu.name: 阿根廷黑白泰加巨蜥
argentine-tegu.description: 阿根廷黑白泰加巨蜥是一種爬行動物。The Argentine black and white tegu is a large, omnivorous lizard native to South America. It has distinctive black and white banding and a robust body. It feeds on a wide variety of foods including insects, small animals, fruit, and eggs.

king-brown-snake.funFact: 棕王蛇嚴格來說是黑蛇而非棕蛇，屬於 Pseudechis 屬。
king-brown-snake.name: 棕伊蛇
king-brown-snake.description: 棕伊蛇是一種爬行動物。The king brown snake, also known as the mulga snake, is one of Australia's most widespread and dangerous snakes. Despite its name, it belongs to the black snake genus Pseudechis. It is responsible for more snakebite deaths in Australia than any other species.

false-gharial.funFact: 假鱷吻部狹窄，類似真鱷但親緣關係不近。
false-gharial.name: 马来鳄
false-gharial.description: 马来鳄是一種爬行動物。The false gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian found in the rivers and swamps of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive long, narrow snout and is one of the largest crocodilian species. It is a specialist fish-eater with a unique jaw structure.

indian-star-tortoise.funFact: 印度星陸龜甲殼上有星形圖案，有助於偽裝和體溫調節。
indian-star-tortoise.name: 印度星龟
indian-star-tortoise.description: 印度星龟是一種爬行動物。The Indian star tortoise is a small to medium-sized tortoise native to India and Sri Lanka. It has distinctive star-shaped patterns on its carapace that radiate from the center of each scute. It is a popular species in the illegal pet trade.

green-anaconda.funFact: 綠水蟒是世界上最重的蛇，部分個體可超過二百二十磅。
green-anaconda.name: 绿森蚺
green-anaconda.description: 绿森蚺是一種爬行動物。The green anaconda is the heaviest and one of the longest snakes in the world, found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It is a non-venomous constrictor that feeds on deer, capybaras, and even jaguars. It spends most of its time in water.

tuatara.funFact: 喙頭蜥是與恐龍同時代的爬行動物目中最後倖存的成員，超過二億年前。
tuatara.name: 楔齿蜥
tuatara.description: 楔齿蜥是一種爬行動物。The tuatara is a reptile endemic to New Zealand and the only surviving member of the order Rhynchocephalia. Often called a living fossil, it has remained virtually unchanged for 200 million years. It has a third eye on top of its head that detects light changes.

eastern-water-dragon.funFact: 澳洲水龍能在水下潛游長達九十分鐘，關閉特殊薄膜防止水進入眼睛。
eastern-water-dragon.name: 东部水龙
eastern-water-dragon.description: 东部水龙是一種爬行動物。The eastern water dragon is a large agamid lizard found along rivers and creeks in eastern Australia. Males have a distinctive red chest and a spiny crest along their back. It is semi-aquatic and an excellent swimmer.

spider-tortoise.funFact: 蜘蛛陸龜因其甲殼上向外輻射的黃色線紋酷似蜘蛛網而得名。
spider-tortoise.name: 蜘蛛陆龟
spider-tortoise.description: 蜘蛛陆龟是一種爬行動物。The spider tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry spiny forests of southern Madagascar. It has distinctive yellow radiating patterns on its dark shell that resemble a spider's web. It is one of the smallest tortoise species in the world.

russian-tortoise.funFact: 俄羅斯陸龜能在嚴冬期間地下冬眠長達六個月以耐受極端溫度。
russian-tortoise.name: 俄罗斯陆龟
russian-tortoise.description: 俄罗斯陆龟是一種爬行動物。The Russian tortoise is a small species native to the arid steppes of Central Asia. It is one of the most cold-tolerant tortoise species, surviving harsh winters by brumating underground. It is popular in the pet trade due to its small size and hardy nature.

cat-eyed-snake.funFact: 貓眼蛇擁有與貓一樣的垂直瞳孔，為其在黑暗雨林中捕食提供優良的夜視能力。
cat-eyed-snake.name: 猫眼蛇
cat-eyed-snake.description: 猫眼蛇是一種爬行動物。The cat-eyed snake is a small, rear-fanged snake found in the tropical rainforests of Central and South America. It has distinctive vertical pupils and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on frogs, lizards, and small mammals.

arabian-chameleon.funFact: 阿拉伯變色龍是少數適應炎熱乾旱沙漠環境的變色龍物種之一。
arabian-chameleon.name: 阿拉伯变色龙
arabian-chameleon.description: 阿拉伯变色龙是一種爬行動物。The Arabian chameleon is a species of chameleon native to the Arabian Peninsula. It is adapted to arid conditions, unlike most chameleon species. It has a casque on its head and can change color for communication and thermoregulation.

spotted-turtle.funFact: 斑點龜深色甲殼上有黃色斑點，隨年齡增長數量增加，如同計算年輪。
spotted-turtle.name: 斑点龟
spotted-turtle.description: 斑点龟是一種爬行動物。The spotted turtle is one of the smallest turtles in North America, found in shallow, slow-moving waters. It has a smooth, dark shell with distinctive yellow or orange spots. It is a long-lived species that can survive for over a century.

banded-krait.funFact: 金環蛇毒性是眼鏡蛇的兩倍，且 regularly 吞食其他蛇類。
banded-krait.name: 金环蛇
banded-krait.description: 金环蛇是一種爬行動物。The banded krait is a highly venomous elapid found in South and Southeast Asia. It has distinctive black and yellow bands and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on other snakes, including venomous species, and is responsible for many snakebite deaths in Asia.

golden-skink.funFact: 黃石龍子擁有金屬般的虹彩光澤，使其看起來像鍍了金。
golden-skink.name: 金石龙子
golden-skink.description: 金石龙子是一種爬行動物。The golden skink is a small, fast-moving lizard found in tropical forests and gardens across South and Southeast Asia. It has a metallic, iridescent body that gives it a golden appearance. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

broad-snouted-caiman.funFact: 寬吻凱門鱷建造植被堆以孵卵，利用分解產生的熱量加溫。
broad-snouted-caiman.name: 宽吻凯门鳄
broad-snouted-caiman.description: 宽吻凯门鳄是一種爬行動物。The broad-snouted caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found in the freshwater habitats of South America. It has a broad, flat snout adapted for catching fish and invertebrates. It builds vegetation mounds to incubate its eggs.

copperhead.funFact: 銅頭蛇造成美國大多數毒蛇咬傷，但其毒液極少致命。
copperhead.name: 铜头蝮
copperhead.description: 铜头蝮是一種爬行動物。The copperhead is a venomous pit viper found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive copper-colored head and hourglass-shaped crossbands. It is responsible for the most snakebite cases in North America, though fatalities are rare.

radiated-tortoise.funFact: 輻射陸龜可存活超過一百年，據報導有個體達一百八十八歲。
radiated-tortoise.name: 放射陆龟
radiated-tortoise.description: 放射陆龟是一種爬行動物。The radiated tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to Madagascar. It has a high-domed shell with striking yellow star-shaped patterns radiating from the center of each scute. It is threatened by habitat loss and poaching for food and the pet trade.

blue-racer.funFact: 藍游蛇是北美最快的蛇類之一，速度可達每小時十六公里。
blue-racer.name: 蓝游蛇
blue-racer.description: 蓝游蛇是一種爬行動物。The blue racer is a fast-moving, non-venomous colubrid found across the central United States and southern Ontario. It has a distinctive blue-grey dorsal color and a white or cream underside. It is diurnal and feeds on rodents, frogs, and other snakes.

side-blotched-lizard.funFact: 雄性側斑蜥蜴使用三種喉部顏色的 rock-paper-scissors 策略來競爭配偶。
side-blotched-lizard.name: 侧斑蜥蜴
side-blotched-lizard.description: 侧斑蜥蜴是一種爬行動物。The side-blotched lizard is a small lizard found in the deserts and grasslands of western North America. It is famous in evolutionary biology for its rock-paper-scissors mating strategy. Males have three throat colors that correspond to different mating tactics.

nile-monitor.funFact: 尼羅巨蜥是出色的游泳者，能在水下閉氣長達一小時。
nile-monitor.name: 尼罗巨蜥
nile-monitor.description: 尼罗巨蜥是一種爬行動物。The Nile monitor is a large, powerful lizard found throughout sub-Saharan Africa near water. It is semi-aquatic and feeds on fish, frogs, birds, eggs, and carrion. It has a forked tongue used for detecting prey in the water.

canebrake-rattlesnake.funFact: 木叢響尾蛇的響尾聲比其他響尾蛇物種安靜，常在沒有警告的情況下攻擊。
canebrake-rattlesnake.name: 藤丛响尾蛇
canebrake-rattlesnake.description: 藤丛响尾蛇是一種爬行動物。The canebrake rattlesnake, a subspecies of the timber rattlesnake, is found in the forests and swamps of the southeastern United States. It has a distinctive pinkish-brown color with dark crossbands. It is a dangerous venomous pit viper.

yellow-footed-tortoise.funFact: 黃腿陸龜在亞馬遜扮演種子傳播的關鍵角色，幫助再生雨林。
yellow-footed-tortoise.name: 黄腿陆龟
yellow-footed-tortoise.description: 黄腿陆龟是一種爬行動物。The yellow-footed tortoise is a medium-sized tortoise native to the Amazon Basin of South America. It has distinctive yellow or orange scales on its legs and head. It feeds primarily on fallen fruit and plays an important ecological role in seed dispersal.

puff-adder.funFact: 膨蝰因其出色的偽裝造成非洲最多蛇咬死亡。
puff-adder.name: 鼓腹咝蝰
puff-adder.description: 鼓腹咝蝰是一種爬行動物。The puff adder is a venomous viper found throughout sub-Saharan Africa. It relies on its excellent camouflage and will not flee when approached, leading to many defensive strikes. It is an ambush predator that strikes with incredible speed.

eastern-green-mamba.funFact: 東部綠曼巴蛇為樹棲型，很少降至地面，終生棲息於森林冠層。
eastern-green-mamba.name: 东部绿曼巴
eastern-green-mamba.description: 东部绿曼巴是一種爬行動物。The eastern green mamba is a fast, highly venomous elapid found in the coastal forests of eastern and southern Africa. It is bright green, blending perfectly with the forest canopy. Unlike the black mamba, it is arboreal and rarely comes to the ground.

cape-dwarf-chameleon.funFact: 開普侏儒變色龍擁有獨立轉動的眼睛，可旋轉一百八十度，提供三百六十度的視野。
cape-dwarf-chameleon.name: 开普侏儒变色龙
cape-dwarf-chameleon.description: 开普侏儒变色龙是一種爬行動物。The Cape dwarf chameleon is a small chameleon endemic to the Western Cape of South Africa. It has independently rotating eyes, a prehensile tail, and a long, sticky tongue for catching insects. It can change color for communication and thermoregulation.

chinese-alligator.funFact: 揚子鱷是最瀕危的鱷目物種，野外僅剩不到一百五十隻。
chinese-alligator.name: 扬子鳄
chinese-alligator.description: 扬子鳄是一種爬行動物。The Chinese alligator is a critically endangered species, one of only two alligator species in the world. Found in eastern China, it is smaller than the American alligator and has bony plates on its eyelids. Wild populations are critically low.

snouted-cobra.funFact: 吹鼻眼鏡蛇能精準噴射毒液達兩公尺，瞄準威脅者的眼睛。
snouted-cobra.name: 唾蛇
snouted-cobra.description: 唾蛇是一種爬行動物。The snouted cobra is a large, highly venomous snake found across southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned snout and can spit venom accurately. It is found in a wide variety of habitats and feeds on rodents, birds, and other snakes.

common-wall-lizard.funFact: 普通壁蜥已從歐洲引入北美，目前在多倫多和溫哥華等城市繁衍興旺。
common-wall-lizard.name: 普通壁蜥蜴
common-wall-lizard.description: 普通壁蜥蜴是一種爬行動物。The common wall lizard is a small, agile lizard found across Europe and introduced to North America. It is commonly seen basking on stone walls and buildings. It feeds on insects, spiders, and small invertebrates.

brown-tree-snake.funFact: 棕樹蛇在關島意外引入後，已導致至少十種鳥類滅絕。
brown-tree-snake.name: 棕树蛇
brown-tree-snake.description: 棕树蛇是一種爬行動物。The brown tree snake is an arboreal, rear-fanged snake native to Australia and New Guinea. It has become one of the world's most destructive invasive species on Guam, where it has eliminated most of the island's native bird species. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds, lizards, and mammals.

angulate-tortoise.funFact: 角陸龜是非洲分布最南的陸龜物種，甚至在涼爽潮濕的西開普省也有發現。
angulate-tortoise.name: 角陆龟
angulate-tortoise.description: 角陆龟是一種爬行動物。The angulate tortoise is a small tortoise found in the fynbos and karoo shrublands of southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned front margin to its shell. It is well adapted to the Mediterranean climate of the Western Cape region.

savannah-monitor.funFact: 草原巨蜥能大幅降低代謝率，每年僅需進食三次大型獵物即可生存。
savannah-monitor.name: 非洲巨蜥
savannah-monitor.description: 非洲巨蜥是一種爬行動物。The savannah monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found across sub-Saharan Africa. It is a ground-dwelling species that digs burrows for shelter. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and reptiles, and is popular in the exotic pet trade.

white-lipped-pit-viper.funFact: 白唇蝮蛇眼睛和鼻孔之間有熱感應窩，能在完全黑暗中偵測溫血動物獵物。
white-lipped-pit-viper.name: 白唇竹叶青
white-lipped-pit-viper.description: 白唇竹叶青是一種爬行動物。The white-lipped pit viper is a venomous snake found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive white or yellow line along its upper lip and is primarily arboreal. It is a nocturnal ambush predator that feeds on rodents and birds.

alabama-red-bellied-cooter.funFact: 阿拉巴馬紅腹龜能長時間曬太陽，利用陽光合成維生素D3以維護甲殼健康。
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.name: 阿拉巴马红腹龟
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.description: 阿拉巴马红腹龟是一種爬行動物。The Alabama red-bellied cooter is an endangered freshwater turtle endemic to Alabama and Georgia. It has a dark shell with a distinctive red or orange plastron. It is found in rivers, lakes, and ponds with abundant aquatic vegetation.

amazon-tree-boa.funFact: 亞馬遜樹蚺的顏色和斑紋變化極大，沒有兩隻個體外觀完全相同。
amazon-tree-boa.name: 亚马逊树蚺
amazon-tree-boa.description: 亚马逊树蚺是一種爬行動物。The Amazon tree boa is a small, arboreal constrictor found throughout the Amazon rainforest. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds and small mammals. It has an extremely variable color pattern, ranging from yellow to red to brown.

california-kingsnake.funFact: 加州王蛇對響尾蛇毒液免疫，在野外 regularly 捕食響尾蛇。
california-kingsnake.name: 加州王蛇
california-kingsnake.description: 加州王蛇是一種爬行動物。The California kingsnake is a popular, non-venomous constrictor found across the western United States. It has a banded pattern of brown and white or yellow. It is an opportunistic feeder that readily eats rattlesnakes, making it beneficial to humans.

clouded-monitor.funFact: 雲巨蜥為樹棲型，擁有鋒利的爪子能輕鬆攀爬垂直樹幹。
clouded-monitor.name: 云巨蜥
clouded-monitor.description: 云巨蜥是一種爬行動物。The clouded monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It is arboreal and has a long, slender body adapted for climbing. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and birds.

brazilian-rainbow-boa.funFact: 巴西彩虹蚺具有虹彩鱗片，在光照下呈現全息彩虹效果。
brazilian-rainbow-boa.name: 巴西彩虹蚺
brazilian-rainbow-boa.description: 巴西彩虹蚺是一種爬行動物。The Brazilian rainbow boa is a medium-sized, non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the stunning iridescent sheen of its scales. It is primarily terrestrial and feeds on rodents, birds, and bats.

northern-cuirassated-lizard.funFact: 北方甲龍蜥擁有稱為皮內成骨的骨質甲板，提供掠食者防護。
northern-cuirassated-lizard.name: 北部甲蜥蜴
northern-cuirassated-lizard.description: 北部甲蜥蜴是一種爬行動物。The northern cuirassated lizard is a small lizard found in the rocky hillsides of Mexico. It has distinctive bony armor plates called osteoderms covering its body. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

desert-iguana.funFact: 沙漠蜥蜴能忍受高達120°F的體溫，使其成為最耐熱的蜥蜴之一。
desert-iguana.name: 沙漠鬣蜥
desert-iguana.description: 沙漠鬣蜥是一種爬行動物。The desert iguana is a medium-sized lizard found in the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It is one of the most heat-tolerant lizards, active at temperatures that force other reptiles to seek shade. It feeds primarily on leaves and flowers.

false-water-cobra.funFact: 假水眼鏡蛇受威脅時會像真眼鏡蛇一樣展平頸部，儘管其毒性僅輕微。
false-water-cobra.name: 伪眼镜蛇
false-water-cobra.description: 伪眼镜蛇是一種爬行動物。The false water cobra is a large, semi-aquatic colubrid found in the wetlands of South America. It displays a cobra-like hood when threatened, despite being only mildly venomous. It is an excellent swimmer and feeds on fish, frogs, and small mammals.

garter-snake.name: 袜带蛇
garter-snake.description: 袜带蛇是一種爬行動物。The common garter snake is one of the most widespread snakes in North America, found in gardens, meadows, and woodlands. It has distinctive longitudinal stripes. Despite being mildly venomous, it is harmless to humans and beneficial as pest control.

shingleback-skink.funFact: 短尾石龍子終生配對，每年繁殖季節與同一伴侶重聚。
shingleback-skink.name: 短尾石龙子
shingleback-skink.description: 短尾石龙子是一種爬行動物。The shingleback skink is a large, slow-moving lizard found in the woodlands and grasslands of southern Australia. It has rough, pinecone-like scales and a short, fat tail that resembles its head, confusing predators. It is one of the few reptile species that mate for life.

mozambique-spitting-cobra.funFact: 莫三比克噴毒眼鏡蛇能精準噴射毒液達三公尺，瞄準威脅者的眼睛。
mozambique-spitting-cobra.name: 莫桑比克射毒眼镜蛇
mozambique-spitting-cobra.description: 莫桑比克射毒眼镜蛇是一種爬行動物。The Mozambique spitting cobra is a highly venomous elapid found across eastern and southern Africa. It is one of the most dangerous snakes in the region, responsible for many snakebite cases. It can spit venom accurately into the eyes of perceived threats.

american-bullfrog.funFact: 美洲牛蛙幾乎能吃掉任何能塞進嘴裡的東西，包括其他青蛙、鳥類甚至蛇類。
american-bullfrog.name: 美洲牛蛙
american-bullfrog.description: 美洲牛蛙是一種兩棲動物。The American Bullfrog is the largest frog in North America. They are powerful swimmers and aggressive predators, known for their deep jug-o-rum calls that can be heard up to a mile away.

glass-frog.funFact: 玻璃蛙腹部皮膚透明，能看到其跳動的心臟和內臟。
glass-frog.name: 玻璃蛙
glass-frog.description: 玻璃蛙是一種兩棲動物。Glass Frogs are remarkable amphibians with translucent ventral skin. Found in Central and South America, they spend most of their lives in trees and descend only to breed near fast-flowing streams.

pacman-frog.funFact: 吃豆人蛙因其巨大的嘴巴和圓滾滾的身體而以電玩角色命名。
pacman-frog.name: 角蛙
pacman-frog.description: 角蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Pacman Frog, also known as the Argentine Horned Frog, is a popular pet species known for its large mouth and sedentary lifestyle. They are ambush predators that sit and wait for prey to pass by.

budgetts-frog.funFact: 布氏蛙受威脅時會膨脹身體並尖叫，使自己看起來更大更具威嚇性。
budgetts-frog.name: 小丑蛙
budgetts-frog.description: 小丑蛙是一種兩棲動物。Budgett's Frog is a flattened, broad-bodied frog found in South America. They are known for their aggressive defensive behavior, including inflating, screaming, and biting when disturbed.

whites-tree-frog.funFact: 白氏樹蛙眼睛上方有脂肪堆積，看起來像眉毛，使牠們永遠帶著微笑。
whites-tree-frog.name: 白氏树蛙
whites-tree-frog.description: 白氏树蛙是一種兩棲動物。White's Tree Frog, also known as the Dumpy Tree Frog, is one of the most docile and popular amphibian pets. Native to Australia and New Guinea, they are known for their placid temperament and ability to thrive in captivity.

african-dwarf-frog.funFact: 非洲侏儒蛙完全水棲，終生生活在水下，與多數青蛙不同。
african-dwarf-frog.name: 非洲侏蛙
african-dwarf-frog.description: 非洲侏蛙是一種兩棲動物。African Dwarf Frogs are tiny, fully aquatic amphibians that never leave the water. They are social creatures that do best in groups and are popular aquarium pets due to their small size and active nature.

amazon-milk-frog.funFact: 亞馬遜奶蛙受威脅時會分泌乳白色毒液，並能從淺藍色變為深藍色。
amazon-milk-frog.name: 亚马逊奶蛙
amazon-milk-frog.description: 亚马逊奶蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Amazon Milk Frog is a large tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have a distinctive black and white or blue and white banded pattern and are named for the milky toxic substance they secrete.

gray-tree-frog.funFact: 灰樹蛙能根據環境和活動水平從灰色變為綠色。
gray-tree-frog.name: 灰树蛙
gray-tree-frog.description: 灰树蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Gray Tree Frog is a small, arboreal frog native to eastern North America. They have bumpy skin that resembles tree bark and bright yellow-orange patches on the inside of their hind legs.

spring-peeper.funFact: 春雨蛙的高頻鳴叫聲在繁殖季節可傳到一英里以外。
spring-peeper.name: 春雨蛙
spring-peeper.description: 春雨蛙是一種兩棲動物。Spring Peepers are tiny tree frogs whose chorus marks the arrival of spring in eastern North America. Their characteristic X-shaped marking on their back helps identify them among other small frogs.

wood-frog.funFact: 木蛙能在完全凍結的狀態下存活，其體內高達百分之六十五的水分會結成冰。
wood-frog.name: 林蛙
wood-frog.description: 林蛙是一種兩棲動物。Wood Frogs are remarkable for their ability to freeze during winter and thaw out alive in spring. Found across North America, they have a distinctive dark mask marking behind each eye.

american-toad.funFact: 一隻美洲蟾蜍每天能吃掉一千隻昆蟲，是絕佳的花園害蟲控制者。
american-toad.name: 美洲蟾蜍
american-toad.description: 美洲蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。The American Toad is one of the most common and widespread toads in North America. They have warty skin, parotoid glands that produce a mild toxin, and can live for over a decade in the wild.

cane-toad.funFact: 甘蔗蟾蜍於一九三五年被引入澳洲以控制甲蟲，卻成為世界上最嚴重的入侵物種之一。
cane-toad.name: 海蟾蜍
cane-toad.description: 海蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。The Cane Toad is a large, toxic toad native to Central and South America. It has become one of the most successful invasive amphibians, spreading across Australia, the Caribbean, and Pacific islands.

fire-bellied-toad.funFact: 火腹蟾蜍受威脅時會展示其明亮的橙紅色腹部，這種行為稱為unken reflex。
fire-bellied-toad.name: 东方铃蟾
fire-bellied-toad.description: 东方铃蟾是一種兩棲動物。Fire-Bellied Toads are small, semi-aquatic toads with bumpy olive-green backs and vivid orange or red bellies. They are popular pets and are known for their aposematic coloration that warns predators of their toxins.

desert-rain-frog.funFact: 沙漠雨蛙受威脅時會發出高音 squeak，聽起來像狗玩具。
desert-rain-frog.name: 沙漠雨蛙
desert-rain-frog.description: 沙漠雨蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Desert Rain Frog is a tiny, round frog that burrows into sand along the coast of South Africa and Namibia. They spend most of their lives underground and emerge only to feed and breed during foggy conditions.

goliath-frog.funFact: 戈利亞蛙是世界上最大的青蛙，重達七磅，體長超過一英尺。
goliath-frog.name: 哥利亚蛙
goliath-frog.description: 哥利亚蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Goliath Frog, or Conraua goliath, is the world's largest frog. Found only in Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea, these massive amphibians inhabit fast-flowing rivers and are threatened by habitat loss and hunting.

mountain-chicken-frog.funFact: 雖然名稱中有雞，山雞蛙並非雞類，而是因其腿肉味道類似雞肉而得名。
mountain-chicken-frog.name: 山鸡蛙
mountain-chicken-frog.description: 山鸡蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Mountain Chicken Frog is one of the largest frogs in the Caribbean, found only on Dominica and Montserrat. They are critically endangered due to the chytrid fungus and habitat destruction.

spadefoot-toad.funFact: 隱蟾蜍能鑽入地下並休眠長達九個月，只在下雨時才出現。
spadefoot-toad.name: 锄足蟾
spadefoot-toad.description: 锄足蟾是一種兩棲動物。Spadefoot Toads are adapted to arid environments with specialized keratinized spades on their hind feet for burrowing. They spend most of their lives underground and breed explosively in temporary rain pools.

natterjack-toad.funFact: 黃條背蟾蜍是歐洲最響亮的兩棲類之一，其叫聲可在一英里外聽見。
natterjack-toad.name: 黄条背蟾蜍
natterjack-toad.description: 黄条背蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。The Natterjack Toad is a medium-sized toad found across Europe. Unlike most toads, they run rather than hop and are known for their loud, rasping calls during breeding season.

midwife-toad.funFact: 雄性產婆蟾將卵纏繞在後腿上直到即將孵化。
midwife-toad.name: 产婆蟾
midwife-toad.description: 产婆蟾是一種兩棲動物。Midwife Toads are small, nocturnal toads named for the male's paternal behavior of carrying eggs on his hind legs. Found across Europe, they have a distinctive high-pitched beep-like call.

european-tree-frog.funFact: 歐洲樹蛙腳趾上具有黏性趾墊，能攀爬光滑表面，包括玻璃。
european-tree-frog.name: 欧洲树蛙
european-tree-frog.description: 欧洲树蛙是一種兩棲動物。The European Tree Frog is a small, bright green frog with a distinctive dark stripe along each side. They are excellent climbers and are often found in gardens, orchards, and damp woodlands.

leopard-frog.funFact: 豹蛙單次跳躍可達體長的二十倍。
leopard-frog.name: 豹蛙
leopard-frog.description: 豹蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Leopard Frog gets its name from the distinctive dark spots covering its green or brown body. Found across North America, they are strong jumpers and swimmers that inhabit a variety of wetland habitats.

strawberry-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 草莓箭毒蛙有超過三十種色彩型態，從紅身藍腿到綠身黃斑不等。
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.name: 草莓箭毒蛙
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.description: 草莓箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Strawberry Poison Dart Frog, also known as the Blue Jeans Frog, is a small but vividly colored amphibian found in Central America. Males carry tadpoles on their backs to suitable pools of water.

dyeing-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 染色箭毒蛙因其毒素被原住民用於染布而得名。
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.name: 染色箭毒蛙
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.description: 染色箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Dyeing Poison Dart Frog is a variable species with striking color patterns. Found in South America, they were named for the use of their skin secretions by indigenous peoples to dye feathers and textiles.

harlequin-toad.funFact: 許多箭毒蛙物種曾被認為已滅絕，近年來重新發現小規模族群。
harlequin-toad.name: 丑角蟾蜍
harlequin-toad.description: 丑角蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。Harlequin Toads are a diverse group of brightly colored toads found in Central and South America. Many species are critically endangered or believed extinct due to the chytrid fungus and habitat loss.

pickerel-frog.funFact: 美洲林蛙產生的毒素能刺激人類皮膚，對其他青蛙則是致命的。
pickerel-frog.name: 美洲狗鱼蛙
pickerel-frog.description: 美洲狗鱼蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Pickerel Frog is a brownish frog with two parallel rows of dark rectangular spots down its back. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few frogs whose skin secretions are toxic to other amphibians.

cherry-tree-frog.funFact: 櫻樹蛙能根據周遭環境從亮綠色變為棕色。
cherry-tree-frog.name: 樱桃树蛙
cherry-tree-frog.description: 樱桃树蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Cherry Tree Frog is a small European tree frog known for its distinctive call that sounds like a cherry pit being clicked. They are excellent climbers with adhesive toe pads.

asian-common-toad.funFact: 亞洲蟾蜍適應力極強，在東南亞人類改造的環境中茁壯成長。
asian-common-toad.name: 亚洲蟾蜍
asian-common-toad.description: 亚洲蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。The Asian Common Toad is a widespread toad found across South and Southeast Asia. They are highly adaptable to urban environments and are often found in gardens, drains, and agricultural areas.

clown-tree-frog.funFact: 小丑樹蛙因在樹間靈巧、雜技般的活動而得名。
clown-tree-frog.name: 小丑树蛙
clown-tree-frog.description: 小丑树蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Clown Tree Frog is a colorful, medium-sized tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have striking patterns of brown, green, and cream that provide excellent camouflage against tree bark.

gliding-tree-frog.funFact: 飛行樹蛙能展開其擴大的趾蹼和帶蹼的腳趾在樹間滑翔。
gliding-tree-frog.name: 滑翔树蛙
gliding-tree-frog.description: 滑翔树蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Gliding Tree Frog has evolved enlarged adhesive toe pads and partially webbed feet that allow it to glide through the rainforest canopy. Found in Central America, they are active at night.

black-legged-poison-frog.funFact: 黑腿箭毒蛙展現雙親照顧，父母雙方共同照護卵和蝌蚪。
black-legged-poison-frog.name: 黑腿箭毒蛙
black-legged-poison-frog.description: 黑腿箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Black-Legged Poison Frog is a small, toxic frog found in the rainforests of Colombia. They are known for their complex parental care behaviors and striking black and yellow coloration.

red-backed-poison-frog.funFact: 紅背箭毒蛙利用其鮮豔色彩警告掠食者其皮膚毒素，這種策略稱為警戒色。
red-backed-poison-frog.name: 红背箭毒蛙
red-backed-poison-frog.description: 红背箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Red-Backed Poison Frog is a small, brightly colored amphibian found in the Amazon rainforest. Their vivid red or orange back serves as a warning to potential predators.

splashback-poison-frog.funFact: 濺背箭毒蛙因其背部色彩斑斕如油漆濺潑而得名。
splashback-poison-frog.name: 溅背箭毒蛙
splashback-poison-frog.description: 溅背箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Splashback Poison Frog is a small amphibian with vivid coloration that varies from green to blue to yellow. Found in South America, they carry tadpoles on their backs to water-filled bromeliads.

cane-turtle-frog.funFact: 甘蔗龜蛙擁有扁平的身體形狀，能躲在岩石和木頭下。
cane-turtle-frog.name: 甘蔗龟蛙
cane-turtle-frog.description: 甘蔗龟蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Cane Turtle Frog is a small, flattened frog found in South America. They are often found in agricultural areas, particularly sugarcane fields, and have a distinctive flattened appearance.

malaysian-horned-frog.funFact: 馬來西亞角蛙眼睛上方有角狀突起，有助於在落葉中破碎其輪廓。
malaysian-horned-frog.name: 马来西亚角蛙
malaysian-horned-frog.description: 马来西亚角蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Malaysian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with distinctive horn-like projections above each eye. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests, they are well-camouflaged among dead leaves on the forest floor.

hampire-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 哈氏箭毒蛙因其醒目的黑橙斑紋而以哈利波特角色命名。
hampire-poison-dart-frog.name: 汉氏箭毒蛙
hampire-poison-dart-frog.description: 汉氏箭毒蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Hamphire Poison Dart Frog is a small, strikingly colored amphibian found in South America. Their bold pattern serves as a warning to predators of their toxic skin secretions.

brazilian-horned-frog.funFact: 巴西角蛙是伏擊掠食者，能數小時不動等待獵物。
brazilian-horned-frog.name: 巴西角蛙
brazilian-horned-frog.description: 巴西角蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Brazilian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with horn-like projections above its eyes. Found in the Amazon rainforest, they are well-camouflaged and lie in wait to ambush passing prey.

hairy-frog.funFact: 雄性毛蛙在繁殖季節會長出毛髮狀皮膚突起，以幫助從水中吸收氧氣。
hairy-frog.name: 毛蛙
hairy-frog.description: 毛蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Hairy Frog, also known as the Trichobatrachus, is a unique amphibian found in Central Africa. Males develop hair-like dermal papillae on their flanks and thighs during the breeding season.

tomato-frog.funFact: 番茄蛙分泌一種黏稠的白色物質，能將掠食者的嘴巴粘住。
tomato-frog.name: 番茄蛙
tomato-frog.description: 番茄蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Tomato Frog is a bright red-orange frog found in Madagascar. When threatened, they inflate their bodies and secrete a sticky white substance that can temporarily immobilize predators.

marsupial-frog.funFact: 袋蛙雌性將卵攜帶在背部的育兒袋中，類似有袋類哺乳動物。
marsupial-frog.name: 有袋蛙
marsupial-frog.description: 有袋蛙是一種兩棲動物。The Marsupial Frog is a remarkable amphibian found in the Andes mountains. Females have a dorsal pouch where they carry their eggs until they develop into froglets, bypassing the tadpole stage.

foam-nest-frog.funFact: 泡沫巢蛙透過後腿攪拌產生泡沫狀巢穴來保護卵。
foam-nest-frog.name: 泡沫巢蛙
foam-nest-frog.description: 泡沫巢蛙是一種兩棲動物。Foam Nest Frogs are found across Africa and South America. They are named for their unique breeding behavior where both sexes whip up a foam nest to protect their eggs from drying out.

surinam-toad.funFact: 蘇里南蟾蜍雌性的卵嵌入背部皮膚中，在此發育成小蛙。
surinam-toad.name: 苏里南蟾蜍
surinam-toad.description: 苏里南蟾蜍是一種兩棲動物。The Surinam Toad is a flat, bottom-dwelling amphibian found in South America. Females have a remarkable reproductive strategy where eggs are embedded in the skin of their backs until they emerge as fully formed froglets.

tiger-salamander.funFact: 虎紋蝾螈是最長壽的兩棲類之一，部分個體在人工飼養下可存活超過二十年。
tiger-salamander.name: 虎纹钝口螈
tiger-salamander.description: 虎纹钝口螈是一種兩棲動物。The Tiger Salamander is the largest terrestrial salamander in North America. They have distinctive yellow or olive markings on a dark background and spend most of their lives underground in burrows.

eastern-newt.funFact: 幼年期的東部蝾螈稱為紅色外小腿，其鮮豔色彩用於警告掠食者其毒素。
eastern-newt.name: 东方蝾螈
eastern-newt.description: 东方蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Eastern Newt has a complex life cycle with three distinct stages: aquatic larva, terrestrial red eft, and aquatic adult. Found in eastern North America, they produce tetrodotoxin in their skin.

hellbender.name: 隐鳃鲵
hellbender.description: 隐鳃鲵是一種兩棲動物。The Hellbender is the largest salamander in North America, reaching up to two feet long. Found in clean, fast-flowing streams of the eastern United States, they are declining due to pollution and habitat loss.

olm.funFact: 洞螈能在不進食的情況下存活長達十年，是最長壽的兩棲類之一。
olm.name: 洞螈
olm.description: 洞螈是一種兩棲動物。The Olm is a blind, cave-dwelling salamander found in the caves of southern Europe. It has no eyes, is depigmented, and can live for over 100 years, making it one of the longest-lived vertebrates.

fire-salamander.funFact: 火蝾螈曾被認為誕生於火焰中，其冰冷的身體能熄滅火焰。
fire-salamander.name: 火蝾螈
fire-salamander.description: 火蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Fire Salamander is one of Europe's most recognizable amphibians with its striking black body and bright yellow or orange markings. Found in central and southern Europe, they secrete samandarin, a neurotoxin.

spotted-salamander.funFact: 斑點蝾螈與棲息在其細胞內的藻類存在共生關係。
spotted-salamander.name: 斑点钝口螈
spotted-salamander.description: 斑点钝口螈是一種兩棲動物。The Spotted Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in eastern North America. They have distinctive yellow spots on a dark background and are one of the few vertebrates known to have algae living inside their cells.

red-backed-salamander.funFact: 紅背蝾螈完全透過皮膚呼吸，成蟲後無肺或鰓。
red-backed-salamander.name: 红背蝾螈
red-backed-salamander.description: 红背蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Red-Backed Salamander is the most common and abundant salamander in eastern North America. They are entirely lungless, breathing through their moist skin, and come in both red-backed and lead-backed color phases.

mudpuppy.funFact: 有外鰓的水生兩棲動物
mudpuppy.name: 泥狗
mudpuppy.description: 泥狗是一種兩棲動物。The Mudpuppy is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. They retain their bushy red external gills throughout life and are nocturnal hunters that use sensory barbels to find prey.

rough-skinned-newt.funFact: 粗皮蝾螈產生的河豚毒素足以殺死數個成年人。
rough-skinned-newt.name: 粗皮渍螈
rough-skinned-newt.description: 粗皮渍螈是一種兩棲動物。The Rough-Skinned Newt is a highly toxic amphibian found along the Pacific coast of North America. They produce tetrodotoxin, the same toxin found in pufferfish, and advertise their toxicity with bright orange undersides.

alpine-salamander.funFact: 高山蝾螈為完全胎生，直接產下發育完全的幼體而非產卵。
alpine-salamander.name: 高山蝾螈
alpine-salamander.description: 高山蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Alpine Salamander is found in the mountains of central and southern Europe. Unlike most amphibians, they give birth to live young that have completed their development inside the mother's body.

great-crested-newt.funFact: 雄性冠蝾螈在繁殖季節會在背部長出鋸齒狀的冠。
great-crested-newt.name: 大冠蝾螈
great-crested-newt.description: 大冠蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Great Crested Newt is the largest newt species in Europe. Males develop a distinctive crest during breeding season and have a white flash on their tail. They are legally protected in many countries.

marbled-salamander.funFact: 雌性虎紋蝾螈會守護卵直到孵化。
marbled-salamander.name: 大理石蝾螈
marbled-salamander.description: 大理石蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Marbled Salamander is a small, stocky salamander with distinctive white or gray crossbands on a dark background. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few salamanders that guard their eggs.

long-toed-salamander.funFact: 長趾蝾螈後腳趾數可達十三個，比多數蝾螈都多。
long-toed-salamander.name: 长趾钝口螈
long-toed-salamander.description: 长趾钝口螈是一種兩棲動物。The Long-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found across western North America. They have a characteristic stripe running down their back and long toes that give them their name.

slimy-salamander.funFact: 黏液蝾螈從皮膚分泌黏稠的膠狀物質，難以去除。
slimy-salamander.name: 粘滑蝾螈
slimy-salamander.description: 粘滑蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Slimy Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in the eastern United States. They secrete a sticky white substance from their skin that helps deter predators.

red-salamander.funFact: 紅蝾螈是北美最大的無肺蝾螈之一。
red-salamander.name: 红蝾螈
red-salamander.description: 红蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Red Salamander is a brightly colored amphibian found in the Appalachian region of the eastern United States. Adults have a distinctive red to orange coloration with scattered black spots.

lesser-siren.funFact: 小水犬能透過鰓和皮膚呼吸，並能鑽入泥土中乾燥生存。
lesser-siren.name: 小蚓螈
lesser-siren.description: 小蚓螈是一種兩棲動物。The Lesser Siren is a fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the southeastern United States. They lack hind legs and can survive drought by burrowing into mud and entering a dormant state.

greater-siren.funFact: 大水犬是水犬科中最大的物種，體長可超過三英尺。
greater-siren.name: 大蚓螈
greater-siren.description: 大蚓螈是一種兩棲動物。The Greater Siren is a large, fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the coastal plains of the southeastern United States. They lack hind limbs and can grow up to three feet long.

three-toed-amphiuma.funFact: 三趾兩棲鰻的退化腿極小，幾乎無法看見。
three-toed-amphiuma.name: 三趾两栖鲵
three-toed-amphiuma.description: 三趾两栖鲵是一種兩棲動物。The Three-Toed Amphiuma is a fully aquatic salamander found in the southeastern United States. It has an eel-like body with three tiny, non-functional toes on each vestigial limb.

waterdog.funFact: 水犬終生保留外鰓，這種現象稱為幼態延續。
waterdog.name: 水狗
waterdog.description: 水狗是一種兩棲動物。The Waterdog is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. Like the mudpuppy, it retains its external gills throughout life and is an important indicator of stream health.

spring-salamander.funFact: 春水螈是少數能終生生活在水中的蝾螈物種之一。
spring-salamander.name: 春蝾螈
spring-salamander.description: 春蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Spring Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in cold mountain streams of eastern North America. They have a distinctive salmon or orange coloration with dark reticulations.

cave-salamander.funFact: 洞螈能利用特化的趾墊攀爬垂直岩壁。
cave-salamander.name: 洞穴蝾螈
cave-salamander.description: 洞穴蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Cave Salamander is a brightly colored salamander with orange to red body and black spots. Found in caves and rocky areas of the eastern United States, they are excellent climbers.

arboreal-salamander.funFact: 樹棲蝾螈能爬樹，並擁有可抓握樹枝的捲尾。
arboreal-salamander.name: 树栖蝾螈
arboreal-salamander.description: 树栖蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Arboreal Salamander is a lungless salamander found in the coastal mountains of California. They are excellent climbers, spending much of their time in oak trees and rock crevices.

ensatina.funFact: 環形螈螈在加州中央谷地形成環形物種，兩端有不同亞種。
ensatina.name: 环口蝾螈
ensatina.description: 环口蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Ensatina is a colorful salamander found along the Pacific coast of North America. They are famous in evolutionary biology as an example of a ring species, with different color morphs forming a circle around California's Central Valley.

slender-salamander.funFact: 細長蝾螈能捲成緊密螺旋狀以保存水分。
slender-salamander.name: 细长蝾螈
slender-salamander.description: 细长蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Slender Salamander is a small, lungless salamander found in California. They have long, thin bodies and can coil into a spiral when disturbed or to prevent water loss.

ringed-salamander.funFact: 帶紋蝾螈在秋季降雨期間遷徙繁殖，是少數秋季繁殖的兩棲類之一。
ringed-salamander.name: 环纹蝾螈
ringed-salamander.description: 环纹蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Ringed Salamander is a large, dark salamander with yellow or white rings or spots. Found in the Ozark Plateau region of the United States, they are one of the few salamanders that breed in the fall.

flatwoods-salamander.funFact: 平滑蝾螈身上有獨特的深色交叉帶紋，有助於在森林地面偽裝。
flatwoods-salamander.name: 平林蝾螈
flatwoods-salamander.description: 平林蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Flatwoods Salamander is a small, threatened salamander found in the longleaf pine forests of the southeastern United States. They breed in temporary fishless ponds and are declining due to habitat loss.

dusky-salamander.funFact: 暗色蝾螈受威脅時能自斷尾巴，斷尾持續扭動以迷惑掠食者。
dusky-salamander.name: 暗色蝾螈
dusky-salamander.description: 暗色蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Dusky Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in eastern North America. They are variable in color and pattern and are often found near streams and springs.

four-toed-salamander.funFact: 四趾蝾螈後腳僅有四趾，不同於多數蝾螈的五趾。
four-toed-salamander.name: 四趾蝾螈
four-toed-salamander.description: 四趾蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Four-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found in bogs and wetlands of eastern North America. They are the only salamander in their range with four toes on their hind feet.

gulf-coast-salamander.funFact: 墨西哥灣岸蝾螈是少數能耐受微鹹水的蝾螈物種之一。
gulf-coast-salamander.name: 墨西哥湾蝾螈
gulf-coast-salamander.description: 墨西哥湾蝾螈是一種兩棲動物。The Gulf Coast Salamander is a small salamander found in the coastal lowlands of the southeastern United States. They are often found in bottomland hardwood forests and can tolerate mildly saline conditions.

tropical-caecilian.funFact: 蚓螈常被誤認為蛇或蠕蟲，但實際上是無足兩棲類。
tropical-caecilian.name: 热带蚓螈
tropical-caecilian.description: 热带蚓螈是一種兩棲動物。Tropical Caecilians are limbless, serpentine amphibians found in tropical regions of the world. They live underground or in leaf litter, feeding on small invertebrates, and are the least known order of amphibians.

boulengers-caecilian.funFact: 布氏蚓螈擁有極微小的退化眼睛，能偵測光線但無法形成影像。
boulengers-caecilian.name: 布氏蚓螈
boulengers-caecilian.description: 布氏蚓螈是一種兩棲動物。Boulenger's Caecilian is one of the largest caecilian species, found in South America. These burrowing amphibians have ring-like grooves along their body and tiny, non-functional eyes buried beneath the skin.

ringed-caecilian.funFact: 帶狀蚓螈擁有一種獨特的感覺器官稱為觸角，能幫助牠們在地下偵測獵物。
ringed-caecilian.name: 环纹蚓螈
ringed-caecilian.description: 环纹蚓螈是一種兩棲動物。The Ringed Caecilian is a limbless amphibian found in South America and the Caribbean. They have a distinctive ring-like pattern on their body and use a chemosensory tentacle to find prey in the soil.

luna-moth.funFact: 月神蛾沒有嘴巴，成蟲後無法進食，僅靠儲存的能量存活。
luna-moth.name: 月神蛾
luna-moth.description: 月神蛾是一種昆蟲。The luna moth is a large, pale green moth with long tail-like hindwings. It is nocturnal and attracted to light, and adults do not feed, dedicating their brief adult lives entirely to reproduction.

atlas-moth.funFact: 阿特拉斯蛾按翅面積計是世界上最大的昆蟲之一。
atlas-moth.name: 皇蛾
atlas-moth.description: 皇蛾是一種昆蟲。The atlas moth is the largest moth species, with a wingspan that can exceed 12 inches. Its wings have snake-head-shaped tips that deter predators, and like other giant moths, adults do not feed.

swallowtail-butterfly.funFact: 雌性鳳蝶能模擬有毒的青斑蝶以避免掠食者。
swallowtail-butterfly.name: 凤蝶
swallowtail-butterfly.description: 凤蝶是一種昆蟲。The eastern tiger swallowtail is a large, bright yellow butterfly with distinctive black tiger stripes. It is one of the most common and recognizable butterflies in eastern North America.

hawk-moth.funFact: 天蛾是飛行速度最快的昆蟲之一，能像蜂鳥一樣懸停。
hawk-moth.name: 天蛾
hawk-moth.description: 天蛾是一種昆蟲。Hawk moths, also known as sphinx moths, are powerful fliers with streamlined bodies. Many species have extremely long proboscises for feeding on deep-throated flowers while hovering.

painted-lady-butterfly.funFact: 小紅蝶能穿越撒哈拉沙漠和地中海遷徙。
painted-lady-butterfly.name: 红蛱蝶
painted-lady-butterfly.description: 红蛱蝶是一種昆蟲。The painted lady is one of the most widespread butterflies on Earth, found on every continent except Antarctica. It is a strong migrant and a common visitor to gardens.

blue-morpho-butterfly.funFact: 摩爾福蝶的藍色並非色素，而是來自微觀鱗片的結構色。
blue-morpho-butterfly.name: 蓝闪蝶
blue-morpho-butterfly.description: 蓝闪蝶是一種昆蟲。The blue morpho is a brilliantly iridescent blue butterfly found in tropical rainforests. Its metallic blue wings are visible from great distances and are produced by light diffraction rather than pigment.

glasswing-butterfly.funFact: 玻璃翼蝶因奈米柱結構而擁有近乎透明的翅膀。
glasswing-butterfly.name: 透翅蝶
glasswing-butterfly.description: 透翅蝶是一種昆蟲。The glasswing butterfly has remarkably transparent wings with only a thin dark border. The transparency is caused by tiny nanopillar structures on the wings that prevent light reflection.

cecropia-moth.funFact: 大蠶蛾是北美最大的原生蛾類。
cecropia-moth.name: 蚕蛾
cecropia-moth.description: 蚕蛾是一種昆蟲。The cecropia moth is North America's largest moth with wingspans reaching 7 inches. It has striking red, orange, and white markings and, like other giant moths, adults do not feed.

io-moth.funFact: 天蠶蛾每隻翅膀上都有一個大而醒目的眼斑，用以驅趕掠食者。
io-moth.name: 月神蛾
io-moth.description: 月神蛾是一種昆蟲。The io moth is a beautiful silk moth with large eyespots on each wing. Males are yellow while females are reddish-brown, and both sexes flash their eyespots when threatened.

polyphemus-moth.funFact: 多眼天蠶蛾以獨眼希臘巨人波呂斐摩斯命名。
polyphemus-moth.name: 波吕斐摩斯蛾
polyphemus-moth.description: 波吕斐摩斯蛾是一種昆蟲。The polyphemus moth is a large, tan-colored silk moth with distinctive eyespots on its hindwings. It is named after the Cyclops of Greek mythology due to the large eyespots.

viceroy-butterfly.funFact: 副王蝶模擬有毒的帝王蝶以求掠食者保護。
viceroy-butterfly.name: 总督蝶
viceroy-butterfly.description: 总督蝶是一種昆蟲。The viceroy butterfly closely resembles the monarch and was long thought to be a mimic. It is now known to be somewhat distasteful to predators, making it a Müllerian mimic.

red-admiral-butterfly.funFact: 紅將軍蝶具領地意識，會驅趕其他蝴蝶離開其喜愛的曬太陽處。
red-admiral-butterfly.name: 优红蛱蝶
red-admiral-butterfly.description: 优红蛱蝶是一種昆蟲。The red admiral is a striking black butterfly with bold red-orange bands and white spots. It is a strong flier found worldwide and often visits rotting fruit and tree sap.

great-spangled-fritillary.funFact: 豹斑蝶幼蟲僅以紫羅蘭為食，該群體因此而得名。
great-spangled-fritillary.name: 大豹蛱蝶
great-spangled-fritillary.description: 大豹蛱蝶是一種昆蟲。The great spangled fritillary is a large, orange butterfly with distinctive silver-spotted underwings. Its larvae feed on various violet species while adults nectar on milkweed and coneflowers.

clouded-yellow-butterfly.funFact: 雲粉蝶是強力遷徙者，能飛行數百英里。
clouded-yellow-butterfly.name: 硫磺蝶
clouded-yellow-butterfly.description: 硫磺蝶是一種昆蟲。The clouded yellow is a bright golden butterfly common across Europe and parts of Asia. It is a strong migratory species that sometimes appears in large numbers in areas outside its normal range.

comma-butterfly.funFact: 鉤蛺蝶因其後翅上白色逗號狀斑紋而得名。
comma-butterfly.name: 钩蛱蝶
comma-butterfly.description: 钩蛱蝶是一種昆蟲。The comma butterfly has uniquely ragged wing edges that help camouflage it as a dead leaf. It has a distinctive white comma-shaped mark on its dark brown underwings.

mourning-cloak-butterfly.funFact: 哀蝶是壽命最長的蝴蝶之一，以成蟲形態越冬。
mourning-cloak-butterfly.name: 荨麻蛱蝶
mourning-cloak-butterfly.description: 荨麻蛱蝶是一種昆蟲。The mourning cloak is one of the longest-lived butterflies, surviving up to 11 months. It overwinters as an adult and is often the first butterfly seen in spring, with dark wings bordered in yellow.

zebra-longwing-butterfly.funFact: 斑馬長翅蝶是佛羅里達州的州蝴蝶，僅靠花粉就能存活。
zebra-longwing-butterfly.name: 斑马长翅蝶
zebra-longwing-butterfly.description: 斑马长翅蝶是一種昆蟲。The zebra longwing is a distinctive butterfly with black wings marked by pale yellow stripes. It is unique among butterflies in that adults can digest pollen, extending their lifespan significantly.

snowflake-butterfly.funFact: 雪花蝶翅膀主要為白色，帶有精緻的黑色尖端。
snowflake-butterfly.name: 雪花蝶
snowflake-butterfly.description: 雪花蝶是一種昆蟲。The snowflake butterfly is a delicate white butterfly found in tropical forests. Its mostly white wings with small dark tips give it a graceful appearance as it glides through forest understory.

resurrection-butterfly.funFact: 復活蝶在日本文化中被視為重生的象徵。
resurrection-butterfly.name: 复活蝶
resurrection-butterfly.description: 复活蝶是一種昆蟲。The resurrection butterfly, known as Kuroneko Yamane in Japan, is a medium-sized butterfly with distinctive markings. It has deep cultural significance in Japan as a symbol of love and resurrection.

cabbage-white-butterfly.funFact: 菜粉蝶是世界上最常見的蝴蝶之一，也是令人頭痛的園圃害蟲。
cabbage-white-butterfly.name: 菜粉蝶
cabbage-white-butterfly.description: 菜粉蝶是一種昆蟲。The small white butterfly is a widespread species often found in gardens and agricultural areas. Its caterpillars are major pests of cabbage and other brassica crops.

atlas-beetle.funFact: 亞特拉斯大兜蟲能搬運自身體重八百五十倍的物體。
atlas-beetle.name: 长戟大兜虫
atlas-beetle.description: 长戟大兜虫是一種昆蟲。The atlas beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle native to Southeast Asian rainforests. Males have three prominent horns used in combat for mates, and they are among the strongest insects relative to size.

goliath-beetle.funFact: 長戟大兜蟲是世界上最重的昆蟲之一。
goliath-beetle.name: 大王花金龟
goliath-beetle.description: 大王花金龟是一種昆蟲。The goliath beetle is one of the largest and heaviest insects on Earth, found in African tropical forests. They feed on fruit and tree sap, and their larvae are among the heaviest grubs known.

rhinoceros-beetle.funFact: 獨角仙能舉起自身體重八百五十倍的物體。
rhinoceros-beetle.name: 犀角金龟
rhinoceros-beetle.description: 犀角金龟是一種昆蟲。The western hercules beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle found in the hardwood forests of North America. Males have a distinctive horn used for wrestling other males during mating season.

stag-beetle.funFact: 雄性鍬形蟲利用巨大的顎與對手爭奪配偶。
stag-beetle.name: 锹甲
stag-beetle.description: 锹甲是一種昆蟲。Stag beetles are named for the large, antler-like mandibles of the males. They spend most of their lives as larvae feeding on decaying wood underground before emerging as impressive adults.

dung-beetle.funFact: 屎殼郎利用銀河導航，是第一種被發現利用星辰的昆蟲。
dung-beetle.name: 蜣螂
dung-beetle.description: 蜣螂是一種昆蟲。Dung beetles roll animal droppings into balls for food or breeding. They are essential decomposers that help recycle nutrients back into the soil and reduce parasite populations in pastures.

tiger-beetle.funFact: 虎甲蟲奔跑速度極快，會暫時失明，因為其眼睛無法快速處理影像。
tiger-beetle.name: 虎甲
tiger-beetle.description: 虎甲是一種昆蟲。Tiger beetles are fast-running predatory beetles with large eyes and powerful jaws. They are voracious hunters of smaller insects and are often found on open, sunlit ground.

longhorn-beetle.funFact: 亞洲長角甲蟲能透過在樹皮下鑽隧道殺死健康的硬木樹。
longhorn-beetle.name: 天牛
longhorn-beetle.description: 天牛是一種昆蟲。The Asian longhorned beetle is an invasive species that attacks a wide variety of hardwood trees. It has distinctive black and white markings and very long antennae that exceed its body length.

click-beetle.funFact: 叩頭蟲能利用點擊機制在不使用腿的情況下彈射到空中。
click-beetle.name: 叩甲
click-beetle.description: 叩甲是一種昆蟲。Click beetles have a unique clicking mechanism on their thorax that allows them to snap and launch into the air when overturned. Their larvae, called wireworms, are important soil dwellers.

bombardier-beetle.funFact: 射水龜從腹部噴射華氏二百一十二度的沸騰化學物質。
bombardier-beetle.name: 放屁甲虫
bombardier-beetle.description: 放屁甲虫是一種昆蟲。The bombardier beetle defends itself by ejecting a hot, noxious chemical spray from its abdomen with an audible pop. The spray reaches temperatures near boiling and repels predators effectively.

june-bug.funFact: 六月金龜子飛行笨拙，經常撞上窗戶和牆壁。
june-bug.name: 六月金龟
june-bug.description: 六月金龟是一種昆蟲。June bugs are chunky, brown beetles that emerge in late spring. They are attracted to lights at night and their larvae, known as white grubs, feed on grass roots and can damage lawns.

whirligig-beetle.funFact: 豉甲擁有四隻眼睛：兩隻用於水面上方視覺，兩隻用於水面下方。
whirligig-beetle.name: 鼓甲
whirligig-beetle.description: 鼓甲是一種昆蟲。Whirligig beetles are aquatic beetles that spin rapidly on the surface of calm water. They have split eyes adapted for both aerial and aquatic vision and are social insects that form groups.

diving-beetle.funFact: 龍蝨翅鞘下攜帶氣泡以在水下呼吸。
diving-beetle.name: 龙虱
diving-beetle.description: 龙虱是一種昆蟲。Predaceous diving beetles are streamlined aquatic predators that hunt tadpoles, small fish, and other insects underwater. They trap air beneath their elytra for extended submerged hunting.

oil-beetle.funFact: 油甲蟲從關節分泌油滴，能驅趕掠食者並使人類皮膚起水泡。
oil-beetle.name: 芫菁
oil-beetle.description: 芫菁是一種昆蟲。Oil beetles are flightless blister beetles that produce cantharidin, a toxic oily substance, from their joints. Their larvae parasitize solitary bees and develop inside their nests.

bess-beetle.funFact: Bess beetle透過摩擦腹部發出吱吱聲來交流。
bess-beetle.name: 大黑天牛
bess-beetle.description: 大黑天牛是一種昆蟲。Bess beetles are large, shiny black beetles that live in decaying wood. They exhibit parental care, with adults feeding and caring for their larvae, which is unusual for beetles.

bark-beetle.funFact: 山松甲蟲爆發能在一年內殺死數百萬英畝的森林。
bark-beetle.name: 小蠹虫
bark-beetle.description: 小蠹虫是一種昆蟲。Mountain pine beetles are tiny bark beetles that bore into pine trees and introduce blue-stain fungi. Massive outbreaks have devastated millions of acres of forest in western North America.

sacred-scarab-beetle.funFact: 古埃及人尊崇聖甲蟲為太陽神凱布利的象徵。
sacred-scarab-beetle.name: 圣甲虫
sacred-scarab-beetle.description: 圣甲虫是一種昆蟲。The sacred scarab beetle rolls dung into balls and was revered in ancient Egyptian culture as a symbol of rebirth and the sun's daily journey across the sky.

carrion-beetle.funFact: 埋葬甲能利用化學感應器從超過一英里外找到死亡動物。
carrion-beetle.name: 埋葬虫
carrion-beetle.description: 埋葬虫是一種昆蟲。The American carrion beetle is a large, flat beetle that feeds on dead animals and snails. It plays an important ecological role in recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem.

patrol-bess-beetle.funFact: 巡邏埋葬甲在受到干擾時會摩擦腹部的脊狀結構來發出聲音。
patrol-bess-beetle.name: 巡逻天牛
patrol-bess-beetle.description: 巡逻天牛是一種昆蟲。The patrol bess beetle is a large, glossy black beetle found in tropical rainforests. Like other passalid beetles, both parents work together to feed and care for their larvae.

eyed-click-beetle.funFact: 眼點叩頭蟲胸部有兩個大型眼狀斑點以驚嚇掠食者。
eyed-click-beetle.name: 眼斑叩甲
eyed-click-beetle.description: 眼斑叩甲是一種昆蟲。The eyed click beetle is a large click beetle with distinctive eyespots on its pronotum. When threatened, it clicks and flips into the air to right itself or escape danger.

rose-chafer.funFact: 玫瑰金龜能在鞘翅閉合時飛行，僅使用後翅。
rose-chafer.name: 花金龟
rose-chafer.description: 花金龟是一種昆蟲。The rose chafer is a metallic green beetle that feeds on flowers, especially roses and fruit blossoms. Despite being considered a pest, its larvae help decompose organic matter in soil.

japanese-beetle.funFact: 日本金龜子釋放聚集信息素吸引更多金龜子前來取食。
japanese-beetle.name: 日本金龟子
japanese-beetle.description: 日本金龟子是一種昆蟲。The Japanese beetle is a highly invasive pest that skeletonizes leaves and damages turf with its white grub larvae. It is native to Japan and has become a devastating pest in North America.

colorado-potato-beetle.funFact: 科羅拉多馬鈴薯蟲是世界上最具殺蟲劑抗性的害蟲之一。
colorado-potato-beetle.name: 科罗拉多马铃薯甲虫
colorado-potato-beetle.description: 科罗拉多马铃薯甲虫是一種昆蟲。The Colorado potato beetle is a major agricultural pest that feeds on potatoes, tomatoes, and eggplants. It has developed resistance to over 50 different insecticides.

lily-beetle.funFact: 百合花甲蟲呈鮮紅色，在綠葉上非常顯眼。
lily-beetle.name: 百合叶甲
lily-beetle.description: 百合叶甲是一種昆蟲。The scarlet lily beetle is a bright red pest of lily plants. Both adults and larvae feed on leaves, stems, and flowers, and the larvae cover themselves in their own excrement for protection.

elm-beetle.funFact: 榆葉甲蟲能透過小縫隙進入室內並在冬季室內冬眠。
elm-beetle.name: 榆叶甲
elm-beetle.description: 榆叶甲是一種昆蟲。The elm leaf beetle skeletonizes elm tree leaves and is a significant urban pest. Adults often overwinter inside buildings, emerging in spring to feed on newly emerged elm leaves.

fire-ant.funFact: 火蟻群落能在洪水期間形成漂浮在水上的活筏，持續數週。
fire-ant.name: 火蚁
fire-ant.description: 火蚁是一種昆蟲。Red imported fire ants are invasive ants native to South America that deliver painful stings causing burning welts. They build large mound nests and can survive flooding by forming floating colonies.

leafcutter-ant.funFact: 切葉蟻是新熱帶區最大的植被消耗者。
leafcutter-ant.name: 切叶蚁
leafcutter-ant.description: 切叶蚁是一種昆蟲。Leafcutter ants cut and carry pieces of leaves back to their nests to feed a special fungus that they cultivate. They are sophisticated farmers with complex division of labor among castes.

bullet-ant.funFact: 子彈蟻的蟄刺被評為世界上最疼痛的昆蟲蟄刺。
bullet-ant.name: 子弹蚁
bullet-ant.description: 子弹蚁是一種昆蟲。The bullet ant gets its name from the intense pain of its sting, which has been compared to being shot. Indigenous tribes use bullet ant stings in coming-of-age rituals.

army-ant.funFact: 行軍蟻群落可達數百萬隻，以巨大的突襲縱隊吞噬路徑上的一切。
army-ant.name: 行军蚁
army-ant.description: 行军蚁是一種昆蟲。Army ants are nomadic predators that form massive raiding swarms. They do not build permanent nests but instead form living bivouacs made of their own bodies while the colony rests.

trap-jaw-ant.funFact: trap-jaw ant能以超過每小時二百二十公里的速度合攏顎部。
trap-jaw-ant.name: 陷阱颚蚁
trap-jaw-ant.description: 陷阱颚蚁是一種昆蟲。Trap-jaw ants have spring-loaded mandibles that snap shut at incredible speeds to capture prey and can also use the force to launch themselves into the air to escape predators.

weaver-ant.funFact: 織葉蟻會使用自己的幼蟲作為活體膠槍將葉片縫合在一起。
weaver-ant.name: 织叶蚁
weaver-ant.description: 织叶蚁是一種昆蟲。Weaver ants build elaborate nests by weaving living leaves together using silk produced by their larvae. They are aggressive defenders of their territory and tend honeydew-producing insects.

honeybee.funFact: 一個蜂巢需採訪超過二十二萬五千朵花才能產出一磅蜂蜜。
honeybee.name: 蜜蜂
honeybee.description: 蜜蜂是一種昆蟲。The western honeybee is the world's most important pollinator of agricultural crops. They live in highly organized colonies with complex social structures and produce honey and beeswax.

bumblebee.funFact: 熊蜂能在比多數蜜蜂更低的溫度下飛行，因為牠們具有調節體溫的能力。
bumblebee.name: 熊蜂
bumblebee.description: 熊蜂是一種昆蟲。Bumblebees are robust, fuzzy bees important for pollinating wildflowers and crops. They are capable of buzz pollination, vibrating their flight muscles to release pollen from flowers.

carpenter-bee.funFact: 木蜂在木材中鑽出完美的圓孔以建造巢穴廊道。
carpenter-bee.name: 木蜂
carpenter-bee.description: 木蜂是一種昆蟲。Carpenter bees are large, solitary bees that bore into untreated wood to create nesting tunnels. Despite their intimidating size, they are gentle and rarely sting, preferring to hover near structures.

paper-wasp.funFact: 紙蜂用咀嚼過的木纖維混合唾液築巢。
paper-wasp.name: 马蜂
paper-wasp.description: 马蜂是一種昆蟲。Paper wasps are slender wasps with long legs that build open-comb umbrella-shaped nests from wood pulp. They are beneficial predators of caterpillars but will sting if their nest is threatened.

yellow-jacket.funFact: 黃蜂群落到夏末可包含四千或更多工蜂。
yellow-jacket.name: 黄蜂
yellow-jacket.description: 黄蜂是一種昆蟲。Yellow jackets are aggressive wasps known for their bright yellow and black markings. They build enclosed paper nests and are notorious for scavenging at picnics and outdoor events.

bald-faced-hornet.funFact: 白臉大黃蜂能從刺中噴射毒液達數英尺。
bald-faced-hornet.name: 白脸大黄蜂
bald-faced-hornet.description: 白脸大黄蜂是一種昆蟲。Despite its name, the bald-faced hornet is actually a yellowjacket, not a true hornet. It builds large, enclosed paper nests high in trees and is known for its aggressive defense of its colony.

european-hornet.funFact: 歐洲大黃蜂對光源有趨性，常在夜間飛入室內。
european-hornet.name: 欧洲大黄蜂
european-hornet.description: 欧洲大黄蜂是一種昆蟲。The European hornet is the largest social wasp in Europe and an invasive species in North America. Queens can reach 1.4 inches in length, and colonies can contain up to 1,000 workers.

tarantula-hawk-wasp.funFact: 沙漠蛛蜂的蟄刺是世界上最疼痛的昆蟲蟄刺之一。
tarantula-hawk-wasp.name: 狼蛛鹰蜂
tarantula-hawk-wasp.description: 狼蛛鹰蜂是一種昆蟲。The tarantula hawk is a large, metallic blue-black wasp that hunts tarantulas to serve as live food for its larvae. Its sting is excruciatingly painful but rarely dangerous to humans.

cuckoo-wasp.funFact: 杜鵑黃蜂受威脅時能捲成球狀，利用其裝甲外骨骼保護自己。
cuckoo-wasp.name: 杜鹃蜂
cuckoo-wasp.description: 杜鹃蜂是一種昆蟲。Cuckoo wasps are brilliant metallic blue or green parasitoids that lay their eggs in the nests of other bees and wasps. Their larvae consume the host's eggs or larvae and stored food.

ichneumon-wasp.funFact: 巨型姬蜂的產卵管可能比身體還長，能鑽穿樹木到達甲蟲幼蟲。
ichneumon-wasp.name: 姬蜂
ichneumon-wasp.description: 姬蜂是一種昆蟲。Giant ichneumon wasps are parasitoids that use their extremely long ovipositors to drill into wood and lay eggs inside wood-boring beetle larvae. Despite their fearsome appearance, they cannot sting humans.

asian-giant-hornet.funFact: 日本大虎頭蜂能在數小時內消滅整個蜂巢。
asian-giant-hornet.name: 亚洲大黄蜂
asian-giant-hornet.description: 亚洲大黄蜂是一種昆蟲。The Asian giant hornet, nicknamed the murder hornet, is the world's largest hornet. Its powerful sting delivers potent venom and it is a devastating predator of honeybee colonies.

sweat-bee.funFact: 部分汗蜂擁有金屬光澤的綠色或藍色身體，在陽光下閃爍。
sweat-bee.name: 汗蜂
sweat-bee.description: 汗蜂是一種昆蟲。Sweat bees are small, often metallic-colored bees attracted to human perspiration for its salt content. They are important pollinators and nest in the ground or in hollow stems.

mason-bee.funFact: 切葉蜂的授粉效率是蜜蜂的一百倍。
mason-bee.name: 壁蜂
mason-bee.description: 壁蜂是一種昆蟲。The blue orchard mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow tubes and crevices. It is a far more efficient pollinator than honeybees, visiting far more flowers per hour.

mining-bee.funFact: 地蜂在巢穴入口處建造小型火山狀的土堆。
mining-bee.name: 地蜂
mining-bee.description: 地蜂是一種昆蟲。Mining bees are solitary ground-nesting bees that excavate tunnels in soil. They emerge in spring and are important early-season pollinators of fruit trees and wildflowers.

golden-digger-wasp.funFact: 金掘土蜂會癱瘓蚱蜢和蟋蟀，以活體餵食其幼蟲。
golden-digger-wasp.name: 金挖泥蜂
golden-digger-wasp.description: 金挖泥蜂是一種昆蟲。The golden digger wasp is a large, metallic golden wasp that hunts grasshoppers and crickets. It buries paralyzed prey in underground nests for its developing larvae.

mud-dauber-wasp.funFact: 泥蜂會將癱瘓的蜘蛛存放在巢中，作為其幼蟲的食物。
mud-dauber-wasp.name: 泥蜂
mud-dauber-wasp.description: 泥蜂是一種昆蟲。Mud dauber wasps are solitary wasps that construct tubular mud nests on sheltered surfaces. They hunt and paralyze spiders to stock each cell for their developing young.

horned-mason-bee.funFact: 雄性角切葉蜂臉上有小型角狀突起，用於求偶展示。
horned-mason-bee.name: 角壁蜂
horned-mason-bee.description: 角壁蜂是一種昆蟲。The horned mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow stems and bee hotels. Males have distinctive facial horns and both sexes are important early-season pollinators.

wool-carder-bee.funFact: 採棉蜂會刮取植物絨毛來襯裡巢穴，因而得名。
wool-carder-bee.name: 梳毛蜂
wool-carder-bee.description: 梳毛蜂是一種昆蟲。Wool carder bees are solitary bees that collect plant hairs to line their nest cells. Males aggressively defend patches of fuzzy plants where females forage for nesting material.

cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: 殺蟬蜂是北美最大的黃蜂，體長可超過兩英寸。
cicada-killer-wasp.name: 蝉杀手蜂
cicada-killer-wasp.description: 蝉杀手蜂是一種昆蟲。The cicada killer is a massive solitary wasp that hunts cicadas to provision its underground nest. Despite its intimidating size, it rarely stings humans unless provoked.

red-velvet-ant.funFact: 絲绒蟻實際上是無翅的蜂，擁有昆蟲界最疼痛的蟄刺之一。
red-velvet-ant.name: 红 velvet 蚁
red-velvet-ant.description: 红 velvet 蚁是一種昆蟲。The red velvet ant is a wingless female wasp with a dense covering of bright red hairs. Despite its ant-like appearance, it is a parasitoid wasp whose sting is extremely painful.

cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: 杜鵑熊蜂滲透其他熊蜂巢穴，將卵產下由宿主養育。
cuckoo-bumblebee.name: 杜鹃熊蜂
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: 杜鹃熊蜂是一種昆蟲。Cuckoo bumblebees are social parasites that take over the nests of other bumblebee species. The female cuckoo bumblebee displaces the host queen and lays her own eggs for the workers to tend.

mosquito.funFact: 只有雌蚊叮咬，需要血液蛋白來產卵。
mosquito.name: 蚊子
mosquito.description: 蚊子是一種昆蟲。The Asian tiger mosquito is an invasive species that can transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika viruses. It is identified by its distinctive black and white striped body and legs.

house-fly.funFact: 家蠅用腳品嚐味道，能從數英里外偵測食物。
house-fly.name: 家蝇
house-fly.description: 家蝇是一種昆蟲。The common house fly is one of the most widespread insects, closely associated with humans. It has sponging mouthparts for liquid feeding and can transmit numerous diseases.

fruit-fly.funFact: 果蠅是基因研究中最重要的模式生物之一。
fruit-fly.name: 果蝇
fruit-fly.description: 果蝇是一種昆蟲。The common fruit fly is tiny but remarkably important in scientific research. They reproduce rapidly and share many genes with humans, making them invaluable for studying genetics and disease.

crane-fly.funFact: 大蚊常被誤稱為巨型蚊子，但不叮咬或吸血。
crane-fly.name: 大蚊
crane-fly.description: 大蚊是一種昆蟲。Crane flies are delicate, long-legged insects that resemble oversized mosquitoes. Adults are harmless and many do not feed at all, while their larvae, known as leatherjackets, live in soil.

horsefly.funFact: 馬虻是飛行速度最快的昆蟲之一，可達每小時一百四十五公里。
horsefly.name: 马蝇
horsefly.description: 马蝇是一種昆蟲。Horse flies are large, powerful fliers with razor-sharp mouthparts that slash skin to feed on blood. Only females bite, and their painful bites can transmit diseases to livestock and humans.

bot-fly.funFact: 馬蠅幼蟲在人類皮膚下發育，形成稱為蠅蛆病的疼痛膿瘍。
bot-fly.name: 狂蝇
bot-fly.description: 狂蝇是一種昆蟲。The human bot fly is a parasitic insect whose larvae develop beneath the skin of mammals, including humans. Adults do not bite; instead, they hijack mosquitoes to deliver their eggs to hosts.

hover-fly.funFact: 食蚜蠅模擬蜜蜂和黃蜂以求保護，但完全無害。
hover-fly.name: 食蚜蝇
hover-fly.description: 食蚜蝇是一種昆蟲。Hover flies are beneficial pollinators that mimic the appearance of stinging insects for protection. Their larvae are important predators of aphids, making them valuable in pest control.

black-fly.funFact: 黑蠅群密度極大，會堵塞牲畜呼吸道導致窒息。
black-fly.name: 蚋
black-fly.description: 蚋是一種昆蟲。Black flies are tiny but relentless biting insects that breed in flowing water. In some regions they transmit river blindness and are considered one of the most important disease vectors.

damselfly.funFact: 豆娘休息時將翅膀沿身體摺疊，與蜻蜓不同。
damselfly.name: 豆娘
damselfly.description: 豆娘是一種昆蟲。Damselflies are slender, delicate relatives of dragonflies that hold their wings together above their body when resting. They are important aquatic ecosystem indicators and voracious mosquito predators.

blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: 藍蜻蜓能倒飛並像直升機一樣懸停。
blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: 蓝晏蜓
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: 蓝晏蜓是一種昆蟲。The blue dasher is a small, common dragonfly with a blue-green body and distinctive wing pattern. It is an agile aerial predator that catches mosquitoes and other small insects on the wing.

emperor-dragonfly.funFact: 帝王蜻蜓每天能吃掉與自身体重相等的昆蟲。
emperor-dragonfly.name: 帝王蜻蜓
emperor-dragonfly.description: 帝王蜻蜓是一種昆蟲。The emperor dragonfly is one of the largest and most powerful dragonflies in Europe. It patrols territories over water and feeds voraciously on mosquitoes, flies, and other flying insects.

four-spotted-chaser.funFact: 四斑蜻蜓是春季最早羽化的蜻蜓之一。
four-spotted-chaser.name: 四斑蜻蜓
four-spotted-chaser.description: 四斑蜻蜓是一種昆蟲。The four-spotted chaser is a robust dragonfly with distinctive dark spots on its wings. It is an aggressive territorial species that perches on vegetation to ambush passing prey.

robber-fly.funFact: 食蟲虻能捕捉並吃掉蜻蜓和蚱蜢等大型昆蟲。
robber-fly.name: 食虫虻
robber-fly.description: 食虫虻是一種昆蟲。Robber flies are aerial predators that intercept prey in flight. They inject victims with saliva that paralyzes and digests their insides, then suck out the liquefied contents.

marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: 食蚜蠅每年在歐洲遷徙數千英里。
marmalade-hoverfly.name: 橙带食蚜蝇
marmalade-hoverfly.description: 橙带食蚜蝇是一種昆蟲。The marmalade hoverfly is a bee-mimic hoverfly that is an important pollinator. Its larvae are voracious aphid predators, making it doubly valuable in gardens and agriculture.

common-mosquito.funFact: 蚊子造成的死亡人數超過歷史上任何其他動物。
common-mosquito.name: 普通蚊子
common-mosquito.description: 普通蚊子是一種昆蟲。Mosquitoes are small, buzzing flies that transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika. Only females bite to obtain blood for egg production, while males feed on nectar.

biting-midge.funFact: 蠓蟲體型極小，能穿過標準紗窗。
biting-midge.name: 蠓
biting-midge.description: 蠓是一種昆蟲。Biting midges are tiny flies that deliver disproportionately painful bites. They are among the smallest biting flies and can be major pests in coastal and tropical regions.

deer-fly.funFact: 鹿虻被深色和二氧化碳吸引，類似蚊子。
deer-fly.name: 鹿蝇
deer-fly.description: 鹿蝇是一種昆蟲。Deer flies are fast-flying, aggressive biters with patterned wings. They transmit tularemia and can cause severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

cattle-bot-fly.funFact: 牛蠅幼蟲附著在牛的舌頭和喉嚨上，造成嚴重不適。
cattle-bot-fly.name: 牛狂蝇
cattle-bot-fly.description: 牛狂蝇是一種昆蟲。The cattle bot fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae develop in the throats of cattle. Adults are bee-like in appearance and do not feed, living only long enough to reproduce.

orchid-mantis.funFact: 蘭花螳螂外觀極像花朵，傳粉昆蟲會直接降落在牠身上。
orchid-mantis.name: 兰花螳螂
orchid-mantis.description: 兰花螳螂是一種昆蟲。The orchid mantis is a stunning pink and white mantis that mimics orchid flowers to ambush pollinators. It is considered one of the most beautiful insects in the world.

ghost-mantis.funFact: 幽靈螳螂外形酷似乾枯的落葉，幾乎隱身不見。
ghost-mantis.name: 幽灵螳螂
ghost-mantis.description: 幽灵螳螂是一種昆蟲。The ghost mantis is a master of camouflage with a body shaped and colored to resemble a dried leaf. It sways gently to mimic a leaf in the wind, hiding from both predators and prey.

leaf-mantis.funFact: 枯葉螳螂不規則的身體邊緣完美複製了破損、腐爛的落葉。
leaf-mantis.name: 叶螳螂
leaf-mantis.description: 叶螳螂是一種昆蟲。The dead leaf mantis is a large, spectacular mantis with a flattened body resembling a dead leaf. It is an ambush predator that waits motionless for prey to come within striking distance.

walking-stick.funFact: 竹節蟲能在蛻皮時再生失去的四肢，部分物種產生有毒的防禦化學物質。
walking-stick.name: 竹节虫
walking-stick.description: 竹节虫是一種昆蟲。Walking sticks are elongated, camouflaged insects that resemble twigs or branches. They are nocturnal herbivores that rely on their extraordinary disguise to avoid detection by predators.

giant-walking-stick.funFact: 巨型竹節蟲保持著世界最長昆蟲的紀錄。
giant-walking-stick.name: 巨型竹节虫
giant-walking-stick.description: 巨型竹节虫是一種昆蟲。The giant walking stick, also known as Chan's megastick, is the longest insect species, with females reaching over 14 inches including legs. It is native to Borneo's tropical rainforests.

american-cockroach.funFact: 蟑螂能在不進食的情況下存活數週，並能閉氣四十分鐘。
american-cockroach.name: 美洲蜚蠊
american-cockroach.description: 美洲蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The American cockroach is the largest common cockroach found in human habitations. Despite its name, it originated in Africa and is now found worldwide in warm, moist environments.

german-cockroach.funFact: 德國蟑螂一隻雌蟲單年可產生多達三萬隻後代。
german-cockroach.name: 德国蜚蠊
german-cockroach.description: 德国蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The German cockroach is the most troublesome indoor cockroach species worldwide. It reproduces rapidly, is resistant to many insecticides, and contaminates food and surfaces with pathogens.

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: 馬達加斯加嘶蟑透過強迫空氣通過特化的呼吸孔發出響亮的嘶嘶聲。
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: 马达加斯加发声蜚蠊
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: 马达加斯加发声蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The Madagascar hissing cockroach is one of the largest cockroach species, reaching 3 inches long. It is famous for the loud hissing sound it produces when disturbed, used for defense and communication.

oriental-cockroach.funFact: 東方蟑螂有時被稱為水蟲，因為牠們偏好潮濕陰暗的環境。
oriental-cockroach.name: 东方蜚蠊
oriental-cockroach.description: 东方蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The oriental cockroach is a large, dark species that prefers cool, damp environments. It is a scavenger that feeds on decaying organic matter and is associated with poor sanitation.

eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: 地下白蟻群落可包含數百萬隻個體共同工作。
eastern-subterranean-termite.name: 东部地下白蚁
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: 东部地下白蚁是一種昆蟲。Eastern subterranean termites are the most destructive termite species in North America. They live in underground colonies and build mud tubes to reach wood structures above ground.

formosan-termite.funFact: 台灣乳白蟻在地上方建造蟻巢，能在約五個月內消耗一根二乘四英寸的木材。
formosan-termite.name: 台湾乳白蚁
formosan-termite.description: 台湾乳白蚁是一種昆蟲。The Formosan termite is one of the most destructive termite species, capable of consuming enormous amounts of wood. Unlike most termites, it can build above-ground nests, making it especially destructive.

dampwood-termite.funFact: 濕木白蟻是北美最大的白蟻，不需要接觸土壤。
dampwood-termite.name: 湿木白蚁
dampwood-termite.description: 湿木白蚁是一種昆蟲。Dampwood termites infest moist, decaying wood and are indicators of excessive moisture problems. They are larger than subterranean termites and do not build mud tubes.

drywood-termite.funFact: 乾木白蟻會踢出稱為frass的微小糞便顆粒，累積在受蛀木材下方。
drywood-termite.name: 干木白蚁
drywood-termite.description: 干木白蚁是一種昆蟲。Drywood termites live entirely within the wood they consume and do not require soil contact. They are difficult to detect and treat because colonies can be scattered throughout a structure.

cicada.funFact: 週期蟬在地下生活十三或十七年後，以數十億隻同步羽化。
cicada.name: 蝉
cicada.description: 蝉是一種昆蟲。Periodical cicadas are famous for their synchronized mass emergences every 13 or 17 years. They are the longest-lived insects and their emergences create deafening choruses heard for miles.

dog-day-cicada.funFact: 伏天蟬因其在夏季最炎熱時節出現而得名。
dog-day-cicada.name: 伏天蝉
dog-day-cicada.description: 伏天蝉是一種昆蟲。Dog-day cicadas are annual cicadas that emerge each summer, unlike their periodical cousins. Their loud buzzing songs fill late summer afternoons in eastern North America.

masked-devil-cicada.funFact: 部分澳洲蟬物種的鳴叫聲是昆蟲界最響亮的，超過一百二十分貝。
masked-devil-cicada.name: 面具魔蝉
masked-devil-cicada.description: 面具魔蝉是一種昆蟲。The masked devil cicada is an Australian species known for its distinctive facial markings. Like other cicadas, it spends years underground before emerging for a brief, noisy adult life.

leafhopper.funFact: 褐飛蝨單次跳躍可達體長的七十倍。
leafhopper.name: 叶蝉
leafhopper.description: 叶蝉是一種昆蟲。The brown planthopper is a major pest of rice crops in Asia. It feeds on plant sap and transmits the devastating rice ragged stunt virus and rice grassy stunt virus.

spittlebug.funFact: 沫蟬若蟲產生稱為cuckoo spit的泡沫狀唾液以保護自己。
spittlebug.name: 沫蝉
spittlebug.description: 沫蝉是一種昆蟲。Spittlebugs get their name from the frothy foam masses their nymphs produce on plant stems. These nymphs, called froghoppers, are sap-sucking insects that can transmit plant diseases.

aphid.funFact: 蚜蟲可透過孤雌生殖方式在不交配的情況下每隻雌蟲產生多達八十隻後代。
aphid.name: 蚜虫
aphid.description: 蚜虫是一種昆蟲。The green peach aphid is one of the most destructive agricultural pests worldwide. It reproduces rapidly through asexual reproduction and transmits over 100 plant viruses.

bed-bug.funFact: 臭蟲能在不進食的情況下存活超過一年，且對多種殺蟲劑具有抗性。
bed-bug.name: 臭虫
bed-bug.description: 臭虫是一種昆蟲。Bed bugs are parasitic insects that feed on human blood at night. They hide in mattress seams, furniture, and wall cracks, and their populations have surged worldwide due to pesticide resistance.

kissing-bug.funFact: 接吻蟲因其在人類睡覺時常叮咬臉部而得名。
kissing-bug.name: 接吻虫
kissing-bug.description: 接吻虫是一種昆蟲。Triatomine bugs, also known as kissing bugs, are vectors of Chagas disease. They feed on blood at night and transmit the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi through their feces.

stink-bug.funFact: 椿象受干擾時從胸部腺體釋放惡臭的化學物質。
stink-bug.name: 臭虫
stink-bug.description: 臭虫是一種昆蟲。The brown marmorated stink bug is an invasive species from Asia that has become a major agricultural pest in North America. It damages fruit crops and invades homes in winter seeking shelter.

box-elder-bug.funFact: 梧桐緣蝽在秋季大量聚集在溫暖的朝南牆壁上。
box-elder-bug.name: 槭树蝽
box-elder-bug.description: 槭树蝽是一種昆蟲。Box elder bugs are black insects with red markings that feed on box elder tree seeds. They become nuisances in fall when they cluster on buildings seeking warmth for winter.

water-strider.funFact: 水黽能在水面上行走，因為其腿上有微觀毛髮能捕捉空氣。
water-strider.name: 水黾
water-strider.description: 水黾是一種昆蟲。Water striders are insects that glide across the surface of calm water using surface tension. Their hydrophobic leg hairs create air cushions that keep them afloat while they hunt prey.

giant-water-bug.funFact: 田鱉又稱咬趾蟲，能造成極度疼痛的咬傷。
giant-water-bug.name: 田鳖
giant-water-bug.description: 田鳖是一種昆蟲。Giant water bugs are large, flat-bodied aquatic predators that prey on fish, frogs, and snakes. Males carry eggs on their backs and are sometimes called electric-light bugs for their attraction to lights.

american-grasshopper.funFact: 鳥蝗蟲飛行能力強，遷徙時能飛行相當距離。
american-grasshopper.name: 美国蝗虫
american-grasshopper.description: 美国蝗虫是一種昆蟲。The American bird grasshopper is a large, strong-flying grasshopper that feeds on a wide variety of plants. It gets its name from its bird-like flight and large size.

desert-locust.funFact: 沙漠蝗蟲群落可覆蓋四百六十平方英里，包含四百至八百億隻昆蟲。
desert-locust.name: 沙漠蝗虫
desert-locust.description: 沙漠蝗虫是一種昆蟲。The desert locust is the most destructive of all locust species. Under certain conditions it transforms from a solitary grasshopper into a gregarious swarming phase capable of devastating crops.

mormon-cricket.funFact: 儘管名稱中有蟋蟀，摩門蟋蟀實際上是盾背螽斯，而非真正的蟋蟀。
mormon-cricket.name: 摩门蟋蟀
mormon-cricket.description: 摩门蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。The Mormon cricket is not a cricket but a large shield-backed katydid that forms migrating bands of billions. They were named after Mormon settlers whose crops they devastated in the 1840s.

field-cricket.funFact: 雄性蟋蟀透過摩擦翅膀發出鳴叫，透過計算鳴叫次數可估算溫度。
field-cricket.name: 田野蟋蟀
field-cricket.description: 田野蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。Field crickets are known for their distinctive chirping songs produced by males to attract mates. They are omnivorous scavengers that feed on plants, fungi, and other insects.

katydid.funFact: 螽斯的鳴叫聲屬於超音波，人類需要特殊設備才能偵測。
katydid.name: 螽斯
katydid.description: 螽斯是一種昆蟲。True katydids are named after their call, said to sound like Katy-did, Katy-didn't. They are leaf-mimicking insects that produce loud, clicking songs at ultrasonic frequencies.

mole-cricket.funFact: 蟋蟀能游泳和飛行，使其成為高度可移動的草坪害蟲。
mole-cricket.name: 蝼蛄
mole-cricket.description: 蝼蛄是一種昆蟲。Mole crickets are burrowing insects with powerful, shovel-like forelegs adapted for digging through soil. They damage lawns and crops by feeding on roots and disrupting soil structure.

snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: 雪樹蟋蟀被稱為溫度計蟋蟀，因為其鳴叫頻率與溫度相關。
snowy-tree-cricket.name: 雪树蟋蟀
snowy-tree-cricket.description: 雪树蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。The snowy tree cricket produces a pure, musical trill and is famous for its temperature-dependent chirping rate. Dolbear's Law uses its chirps to estimate ambient temperature.

human-head-louse.funFact: 頭虱至少已伴隨人類一萬年。
human-head-louse.name: 头虱
human-head-louse.description: 头虱是一種昆蟲。Human head lice are parasitic insects that live on the scalp and feed on blood. They are wingless and highly adapted to life on humans, spreading through direct head-to-head contact.

body-louse.funFact: 體虱已被用於透過DNA分析追蹤人類遷徙模式。
body-louse.name: 体虱
body-louse.description: 体虱是一種昆蟲。Human body lice live in clothing and emerge to feed on blood. Unlike head lice, they can transmit serious diseases including typhus, trench fever, and relapsing fever.

human-flea.funFact: 跳蚤能跳躍體長的一百五十倍，相當於人類跳過摩天大樓。
human-flea.name: 人蚤
human-flea.description: 人蚤是一種昆蟲。The human flea, Pulex irritans, is the original flea species associated with humans. It is a blood-feeding parasite that can transmit diseases and has been a companion of humans for millennia.

cat-flea.funFact: 貓蚤是全球家寵上最常見的跳蚤物種。
cat-flea.name: 猫蚤
cat-flea.description: 猫蚤是一種昆蟲。The cat flea is the most common flea species affecting domestic cats and dogs. Despite its name, it infests many mammal species and can cause allergic dermatitis and transmit tapeworms.

oriental-rat-flea.funFact: 東方鼠蚤是黑死病期間鼠疫的主要傳播媒介。
oriental-rat-flea.name: 亚洲鼠蚤
oriental-rat-flea.description: 亚洲鼠蚤是一種昆蟲。The oriental rat flea is historically the most important disease vector among fleas, having transmitted bubonic plague during the Black Death. It feeds primarily on rats and other rodents.

brown-recluse-spider.funFact: 棕色遁蛛毒液能造成需要數月才能癒合的壞死性潰瘍。
brown-recluse-spider.name: 棕色遁蛛
